avis.texte: Started to use this product after finding out my other cream wasn’t a “clean” option. This has a good rating on the Yuka app. We live in the Midwest where it’s very dry in the winter. This product has completely changed my skin texture for the better! I’ve been using daily for at least a month and a half, and the bumps on my arms are completely gone. It’s very thick - but I personally like that about it.

avis.titre: Best product EVER for dry, itchy, cracked skin
avis.texte: Know it may sound gross but my feet were so dry and starting to crack at the heels that they were just itchy from the dryness. This product stopped the itching immediately when I applied it heavily but to only the point it absorbed into the skin. Put some fuzzy soft aloe socks on to wear overnight. Then the next day applied it the same way before I put on my regular sock and sneakers for work. That night my feet didn't feel dry or itchy at all like they normally do when I do this with other lotions thay say they are for dry skin. This really sold the problem and I will continue to use it and recommend to all my friends especially those sensitive to scents and going through medical treatments that have to be careful on what they use. Thank you Cetaphil for making this wonderful product line for those of us who just want to feel better and cure the problem without creating a new one!

have mature combination skin, and this cream has been exceptional. It provides deep hydration without feeling greasy or heavy, which can be hard to find. My skin feels soft, smooth, and comfortable all day, and it layers well under makeup. I’ve tried many high-end moisturizers over the years, and this one honestly performs just as well—if not better—for a fraction of the price. If you’re looking for a non-greasy, highly moisturizing cream for mature skin, I highly recommend giving this one a try.

I like the absorption and feel of this lotion. I believe the ingredients are good and it works well on my dry skin. I do not like the packaging because it’s difficult to get all of the product out. Next time I will buy it in a pump.

This has been the first lotion to actually give me lasting relief to my dry spots- knees, elbows, ankles and shins. My skin is left feeling soft and smooth without greasiness and I really love the “radiant” sheen it leaves. It’s a very subtle effect but I really love it. I want to try the lotion version of this next!

avis.titre: Good quality product for face and neck area.
avis.texte: I really like this for my face and neck after a shower. The hydration is long lasting. Not intended for wrinkle removal but I think it helps maintain skin softness.
Bought this strictly for my tattoo, but started using it all over. Thicker with no scent. Great for hydrating skin but doesn't give that shine I enjoy. Still glad I bought it.
I ordered this from same seller before. It was good the last time. This time it smells bad. I am really not satisfied. I will try to upload the picture.

The cream is worth the money. It’s a very thick cream ,which is something that I like the most about this product. I like how you squeeze out a very small amount and it will be enough for your entire face. The cream leaves my face very moisturized . Very effective and will be very long lasting.

By day 2 my hands no longer look so dry. By day 8 my hands look great again. I work in retail so the cold really dried it up by the time I got gloves I realized the damage was done. I needed help and my sister recommended this brand. I use it twice a day once before going to work and once before bed. And it's done wonders.
I love this product. It goes on smooth when I apply it. And it's not sticky. It's light weight, but it does to work.

avis.titre: Keeping my skin soft and hydrated
avis.texte: Cetaphil is one of my favorite brands for affordable and basic skin care products. The Cetaphil advanced relief cream with shea butter works wonders on dry skin. The tube is 6 oz and the top is shrinked wrapped so you can ensure that it hasn’t been tampered with. The cream works great on all parts of the body. I mainly use it on my legs and feet, since they seem to get the driest. The cream is a white color and has a good consistency that spreads easily. It absorbs quickly and does not leave a greasy feeling. I love that the cream is fragrance free so all the guys in my home can also use it. I’ve been using this cream daily for over a month and my skin is always soft and hydrated.

avis.titre: Best moisturizer for my dish-weary hands that I've tried to date
avis.texte: Product: Cetaphil Advanced Relief Cream with Shea Butter for Continuously Dry, Sensitive Skin, 48 Hour Hydration, All Skin Tones & Types, Hypoallergenic, Fragrance Free, Dermatologist Recommended, 6 Oz Thick. Absorbs slower than lighter lotions, but still in less than 5 min. This is the only lotion that feels like it actually improves my skin after spending hours washing the dishes. It does not leave any significant residue. It even says it's non-noncomedogenic. Not currently using it on my face but I don't have to worry if I touch my face after using this. Really like this lotion
This is a good lotion. The size is decent. The smell is good, not overpowering. This goes on smoothly and makes my skin feel very soft and refreshed.
Cetaphil makes great stuff. This relief cream with Shea butter is no exception. It is fragrance free and hypoallergenic. Awesome stuff to keep on your bedside before sleeping. Strong recommendation.

Highly recommend! I've been using for a week and my hands are a lot softer and smoother! The cream is thick, but not greasy at all! It doesn't make my skin super oil, even in summer. I think it's good for all skin types.

I have sensitive skin and this didn’t irritate it. I like the ingredients in this including the Shea Butter. The cream always left my skin feeling healthy and smooth. I struggle with dry skin and this improved my skin overall.
